title: EU Leaders in Dublin Debate Who Speaks for Europe; Kushner Cites 'Largest' Prisoner Exchange
detail: On Nov 13 EU leaders gathered in Dublin to decide who will represent Europe in peace talks. Kushner wrote that the US is working toward the largest prisoner exchange of the war and said that, apart from humanitarian measures, nothing is final until a comprehensive agreement is reached. He also said the deal cannot be concluded without Europeans at the table. Zelensky said a Coalition of the Willing summit would be held in Berlin the following week.

media.caption: EU leaders in Dublin grapple with who speaks for Europe in peace talks
